definition: giving up the device entirely, and the two drains that ended together when I did

settled:
It was the largest single move I have made on my surroundings, and it has been enough so far.

I sized it against the pressure it had to answer. Events in this country had taken my safety low enough that I was seriously weighing moving to another one. A tactical adjustment would not have touched that. Only something structurally large would.

The device carried two drains at once. It was over ninety per cent of how the wider world reached me, with no television, no newspapers, no magazines, no social media, and few people around me handing me the news.

And it had become a cue in its own right. Pairing the thing in my hand with what it delivered, over and over, while my safety was low, encoded the device itself. Picking it up retrieved the state whether or not the apps were still on it.

So both had to go together. Apps alone leaves the cue. The device alone just encodes whatever channel replaces it.
